Sam: Quick async check on the Dedicated capacity slate — posting current statuses + tiny asks. TL;DR: PO in flight, 2 racks delayed by power check, need one CR and one canary date.
Maya: PO# 2026-88 submitted yesterday to vendor, ETA per vendor email = 2026-04-12 for shipment. I attached invoice in the procurement ticket.
Leo: Noted. Rack-level PDUs flagged in last power audit — two cabinets (rack-07, rack-09) need breakers swapped. Eng-infra ops can do it, but need on-site window.
Olivia: I can schedule the breaker swap Wed 4/8 morning. FYI lab techs need 30m.
Ara: @Olivia please put the maintenance window in the calendar and tag @oncall so we have coverage. Also we need an updated runbook for post-swap smoke tests.
Olivia: Will add window and ping oncall. I can draft a quick smoke checklist, copying the existing node-qa runbook.
Sam: Good. On the software side: images baked with CUDA 12.2 + custom driver patch v2.0.1. Leo can you run the kernel-compat test once racks are live? Command I used locally:
```
./ci/check-kernel-compat.sh --nodes rack-07,rack-09 --image redwood/runtime:cudapatch-2.0.1
```
Maya: Vendor also confirmed we can swap one H100 node per rack for canary on delivery day. Recommend we plan canary on day+1 after install to run perf/latency baseline.
Leo: Agree. For canary we need: perf harness, KV-cache warmup, 1000 short-request run, and 100 long sequence runs. I can wire the perf suite; need CR @Sam on the perf-config PR (#3482).
Sam: Pinged for CR. @Maya can you drop the PO tracking link here? I can't find the updated timeline in Confluence.
Maya: Link: https://procurement.redwood/PO/2026-88 — shows shipment pending customs clearance ETA 4/12. I'll also add the vendor contact number.
infra-bot: [notice] Rack provisioning ticket #CAP-412 transitioned to "awaiting-ops" by Maya at 1834507120.
Ara: Dependency note: Dedicated capacity reservations team needs the final node count by 4/10 to lock monthly billing. We currently have provisional qty=18, pending 2 nodes if vendor substitutes different SKUs.
Sam: Action items:
- Maya: confirm final SKU list with vendor and update CAP-412 (due 4/9)
- Olivia: schedule breaker swap & post-swap smoke checklist (due 4/8)
- Leo: run kernel-compat + perf canary suite post-install (tentative 4/13)
- Sam: merge perf-config CR once reviewed, then schedule canary window.
Maya: I'll update CAP-412 now. One ask: vendor may ship mixed firmware revs, can infra ops normalise firmware? If not, we may delay.
Leo: We can hotpatch firmware for the NICs but prefer vendor flash in staging. I'll prepare the firmware remediation playbook.
Sam: Final ask — can someone in Product/Platform confirm acceptance SLOs for canary? We need latency targets for the 1000 short requests. If no answer by EOD 4/9 we'll run with default SLO = p95 < 60ms for 8k token seqs.
Ara: I'll ping Platform leads separately. Adding note to CAP-412 so it's visible.
Olivia: Scheduled breaker swap Wed 4/8 09:00-09:45, invited @oncall, CAP-412 updated.
Sam: Thanks all. Will follow up after CR and vendor SKU confirmation. Small follow-up: @Leo, can you leave a one-line summary in the perf run ticket after canary? makes billing handoff easier.
Leo: Yep, will do.
Sam: closing this thread for now — will post canary date once CR merged and racks are green. :thumbsup:
